caption: The drawing depicts a round plate featuring a central symmetrical floral design. The plate's border is wide and brown, with an inner decorative band composed of a yellow wavy pattern outlined by a thinner brown wavy line. Inside the central field, two main curved brown stems rise from the bottom, each splitting off to form additional branches adorned with stylized brown flowers resembling tulips at the top and sides. Accompanying the stems and flowers are green leaf shapes scattered throughout the composition. Two additional symmetrical circular floral motifs in brown, with crosshatch and linear details, are located on either side of the lower portion of the design. The background of the plate's central area is light yellow-green, with additional green brush marks interspersed behind the main design. Below the circular plate, there are two outline sketches, one on each side, showing the plate's profile or edge view. The artist's name “C. GARJAN” is inscribed on the lower left corner outside the plate design.
title: Pa. German Plate
